Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); no new user setting or workflow requires a guide. decisions.rationale: Reduces FAT image cluster waste while keeping image size and packaged contents unchanged; it introduces no user setting or workflow.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): The embedded INI drive uses 512-byte clusters so the definition and documentation fit without enlarging the image.

[firmware/hw_layer/mass_storage/create_ini_image.sh](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/hw_layer/mass_storage/create_ini_image.sh): The image is created with one sector per cluster and the extraction round-trip preserves the packaged INI.
